mapping_note: OVERTURNED IN REVIEW from a proposed 17-3023, by both reviewers independently, and the reason is the SOC-2019 fold-back trap in its purest form. In SOC 2010 - the taxonomy Felten indexes - EVERY engineering-technologist occupation lived under 17-3029: .02 Electrical Engineering Technologists, .03 Electromechanical, .04 Electronics, .05 Industrial, .06 Manufacturing, .07 Mechanical, .11 Nanotechnology. SOC 2018 dissolved them into the discipline codes and renamed those codes 'Technologists AND Technicians', which is why the string now surfaces at 17-3023.00 (src=02), 17-3027.00 (src=02) and 17-3026.00 (src=08). All three fold back to 17-3029, so the 11.22-point 'coin flip' between 17-3023 (71.98) and 17-3027 (60.76) that the first draft disclosed does not exist - those are the same SOC-2010 code. Rejected 17-3022 Civil (85.82, 13.84 above, src=10, the one anchor with no 2010 technologist predecessor and the weakest provenance) and 17-3026 Industrial (78.15, 9.92 above) on discipline. That reading has zero O*NET anchor against a string anchored at five codes, so the recorded 'a verbatim anchor governs' holding decides it - but this is the batch's single largest exposure and the row to re-review first.
